Laura / Monica — draft commercial sketch below. Kept intentionally short so procurement can paste into their deck. I'm available to jump on a 20m call with Emma if they'd like.

Commercial sketch (for NewLeaf Health) — 3-site pilot -> production ramp- Pilot (3 months):
  - Operator license (per-site, pilot): 3 x $9,000/mo (includes node orchestration & operator dashboard)
  - Model serving node (per-GPU equivalent) meter: 6 x $3,500/mo (pilot sizing)
  - Platform fee (monthly, amortized for pilot): $12,000/mo (covers private control plane, telemetry retention 30d)
  - Starter credit: one-time $36k offset for pilot (applied to first 3 invoices)
- Production (annualized, after pilot):
  - Operator license: 3 x $7,500/mo (volume price)
  - Model serving nodes: 18 x $2,800/mo (expected scale)
  - Platform fee (staggered amortization): $9,000/mo (customer can opt to amortize annual platform fee over 12 months)
  - Support: Standard (Mon-Fri): included; 24/7 SRE retainer: $7,500/mo per account (recommended for clinical workloads)

Exit protection / egress concession (standard offer):
  - If contract terminated for convenience within first 12 months, Redwood provides a one-time egress credit equal to 20% of prepaid platform & operator fees (capped at $150k) and assistance with data export tooling.
  - For healthcare customers with strict retention rules, we offer an extended export window (additional 30 days) at no extra cost during transition.

SLA crediting (high level):
  - P1: 1-hour response target; credit = 10% service fee for the month if SLO breached more than twice.
  - P2: 4-hour response target; credit = 5% service fee if missed repeatedly.

Negotiable levers:
  - Increase starter credit (up to 50% of pilot fees) for multi-year commitment.
  - Swap part of platform fee into one-time setup invoice to reduce monthly burn.
  - Reduce support retainer in exchange for a higher platform prepay.

I'll attach a pricing workbook and support tier matrix. If this looks OK I can convert to a single-page commercial summary and DocuSign-ready quote.

Ben

Alternate posture (pilot-first with platform deferral):

- Operator licenses (pilot): 3 x $8,500/mo (includes 1 on-call rotation for first 3 months).
- Node units: pilot 6 x $3,300/mo -> production 18 x $2,600/mo (volume ladder).
- Support: Clinical SRE retainer (recommended): $6,500/mo with a 6-month minimum; includes 24/7 paging for P1.

Concession for healthcare pilot:
- Exit protection: 30% egress credit of prepaid platform/operator fees if NewLeaf terminates within the first 12 months, capped at $200k. We will also include a free 45-day export window and a technical runbook for handover.
